svg.title: N0zoM1z0 · Contribution Arcade · 03 / PAC-MAN
svg.desc: 13,951 GitHub contributions across 138 active days, 2025-10-12 to 2026-10-14. Pac-Man eats one pellet per active date, from smaller contribution counts to larger ones. Actual consecutive-day streaks increase his pace; three ghosts pursue the same connected maze trail.
